=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description states "It makes at most two REST calls, and only when something needs syncing (§15)."
  Expected change site: `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py` in `_classify_paths` and `_open_or_refresh_pr`.
  Evidence of absence: `_commit_authorization` (lines 176-227 in PR diff) makes one `gh api` call per distinct template commit to fetch PR associations, plus up to 3 paginated calls per merged PR to fetch commits. `_open_or_refresh_pr` (lines 289-338 in PR diff) makes additional calls to list and create PRs. The actual API budget documented in `agents.md` (line 780 in PR diff) is "at most one association lookup per distinct template commit, 1-3 pages per distinct merged PR, and two sync-PR lookups plus at most one create/convert per nonempty group" — significantly more than "two REST calls". The PR description understates the API cost by an order of magnitude for PRs with multiple template commits.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description — "It makes at most two REST calls, and only when something needs syncing (§15)."
  Expected change site: PR description (statement of API budget for `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py`); cross-referenced against the actual code in `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py` and the agents.md documentation in the same PR.
  Evidence of absence: The code contradicts this claim. `_classify_paths` (scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py) calls `_commit_authorization` once per distinct template commit (default cap 30), and `_commit_authorization` issues one `repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}/pulls` lookup per commit plus up to 3 pages of `repos/{repo}/pulls/{n}/commits` per merged PR. `_open_or_refresh_pr` adds a PR lookup plus a create/convert per nonempty group. The same PR's agents.md addition accurately documents this: "The API budget is at most one association lookup per distinct template commit, 1-3 pages per distinct merged PR, and two sync-PR lookups plus at most one create/convert per nonempty group." So the PR description and agents.md in the same PR contradict each other, and the code matches agents.md, not the PR description. The "at most two REST calls" claim was never accurate for this code, even before the #6375 provenance-hold commit was merged in. This is a PR-description inaccuracy, not a code defect — the code and agents.md are correct. Operators relying on the PR description's claim for rate-limit budgeting would underestimate the API cost by an order of magnitude on a 30-commit push.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2
